name: Server Hardware Variations
description: Different server hardware configurations (CPU, memory, network) can introduce subtle variations in the timing of the coin flips, leading to multimodal latency.

name: Network Latency
description: High latency between the servers and the monitoring systems can significantly impact the timing of the coin flips.

name: Data Packet Size & Flow
description: The size and rate of data packets being exchanged between the servers can influence the randomness of the coin flips and the time it takes for the counter to stabilize.

name: Server Cooldown/Synchronization
description: Server cooldown periods or synchronization mechanisms can introduce delays that affect the arrival of the coin flip results, affecting the multimodal behavior.

name: Cache States
description: Cache state impacts how frequently the servers are reading their data.  More frequent reads could lead to more variability.

name: System Load
description: High system load can introduce delays and inconsistencies across the system, potentially affecting the randomness of the coin flips.

name: Operating System Tuning
description: Differences in OS tuning can subtly alter the timing of the coin flips.

name: Memory Allocation & Usage
description: Allocation patterns can affect the arrival of data, influencing the coin flip results.

name: DNS Latency
description: Latency during DNS resolution can impact the timing of the coin flip results.

name: Protocol Rounding Errors
description: Even small rounding errors in the protocol can manifest as multimodal behavior.

name: Server Resource Contention
description: If one server is experiencing significant resource contention, it can introduce variations that complicate the analysis.

name: Sequential Updates
description: The way the server updates their counters (e.g., sequentially vs. concurrently) can influence the multimodal behavior.

name: Timing of the Agreement
description: The specific timing of the servers agreeing on a value could be a factor, though it's likely minor.

name: Temperature Variation
description: Variations in server temperatures can affect hardware performance.

name: Network Topology
description: The structure of the network connecting the servers can influence the propagation of the coin flip results.
